verdict.rationale: Claude's own docs say it accepts uploads of PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, ODT, RTF, EPUB, JSON and more. It analyzes both text and visual elements such as charts in PDFs of 100 pages or fewer, and files can be kept in a project for reference across conversations. That covers uploading documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs for analysis. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on evidence of analysis accuracy, no detail on spreadsheet analysis depth, and visual PDF analysis is documented only up to 100 pages.
